overall: The AG found no OML violation: the Chair may limit public participation under G.L. c. 30A, § 20(f), so a three-minute limit at the November 7 meeting was permitted, though the AG encouraged broader public participation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council violated the OML by limiting public speakers to three minutes each at its November 7 meeting, dismissing those opposed to a City agreement.
allegations.key_passage: It is within the Chair's discretion to limit public participation during a meeting, and thus the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law by limiting public comment to three minutes each during the November 7 meeting.
